heading: EXT. HOLLOW BANYAN TREE - OBSERVATION POST - DAWN

units.text: EXT. HOLLOW BANYAN TREE - OBSERVATION POST - DAWN
A giant tree, its heart rotted out, with a crude firing slit chopped through the bark.
Inside, a cramped hollow barely wide enough for two men and a field radio.
Mist drifts in the jungle outside.
PRIVATE ABEBE (20s, spectacles taped at the hinge) kneels at the slit with a pair of binoculars.
SERGEANT HOLLIS (40s, grey stubble, sleeves rolled) sits against the wall, shaving with a tin mirror and a cold razor.
Nothing.
units.name: ABEBE

units.text: Nothing is good.
units.name: HOLLIS

units.text: Nothing's been good for six hours, Sarge. I keep waiting for it to turn bad.
units.name: ABEBE

units.text: It will. Hand me that rag.
units.name: HOLLIS

units.text: Abebe passes a rag.
Hollis wipes his chin and examines the result in the mirror.
You want some coffee?
units.name: HOLLIS

units.text: There's coffee?
units.name: ABEBE

units.text: There's instant. And a canteen of water that tastes like a boot.
units.name: HOLLIS

units.text: He pours powder into a tin cup, adds water, and hands it to Abebe, who sips, winces, sips again.
It's terrible.
units.name: ABEBE

units.text: Wait until you've been here a year. It'll taste like home.
units.name: HOLLIS

units.text: You've been here four years.
units.name: ABEBE

units.text: That's a long time to drink bad coffee.
units.name: HOLLIS

units.text: Abebe laughs.
It's the first laugh in the tree in days.
He sits next to Hollis, lowers the binoculars.
The mist thins.
Far off, a bird starts up.
Sarge, do you think they're out there?
units.name: ABEBE

units.text: I think they were. Yesterday.
units.name: HOLLIS

units.text: What changed?
units.name: ABEBE

units.text: Hollis looks at him.
Then, slowly, reaches for the field radio, turns the dial.
Static.
Then a thin, clear VOICE in English, reading a message in a loop.
Abebe goes still.
Hollis lets it play.
That's the ceasefire. That's the actual...
units.name: ABEBE

units.text: Came through at midnight.
units.name: HOLLIS

units.text: You've known for six hours?
units.name: ABEBE

units.text: Hollis switches off the radio.
The silence is loud.
I wanted him to finish his coffee before I told you.
units.name: HOLLIS

units.text: Abebe stares at the cup in his hand, then at Hollis.
He puts the cup down very carefully, as if it might break.
Sarge.
units.name: ABEBE

units.text: Go on, kid. Say it.
units.name: HOLLIS

units.text: Thank you.
units.name: ABEBE

units.text: Hollis looks away, rubbing his freshly shaved jaw.
Outside the slit, the sun clears the trees.
